nature: Fixed look fitted to the development references (supervised origin: NLP default conversions and shop_r01 colourist JPEGs). Per-frame inference reads only these constants, never a reference image. Not a calibration of any scanner, light or film; not part of the engine defaults (Sprint 1 output unchanged).

fit.train: nlp_official (12 frames) + shop_r01 (21 paired frames, DSC_3822 and DSC_3858 excluded)

caveats: contrast sits at its upper bound (2.0) in every fit; bounds were not widened (decision S2-6/S2-7)
shoulder differs strongly between the references (fit on nlp 0.90, on shop 0.08): a style difference, the pooled value follows the shop roll
frames weighted equally, so the 21 shop frames outweigh the 12 NLP frames
only two scanner set-ups (Fuji X-T2 X-Trans, Nikon Z 7II Bayer) and few films: may encode scanner bias rather than a general look
development-set scores only; not evidence of generalisation
